title: Row marginals sum to one
statement:
Let $\sigma$ be a joint distribution over $\mathrm{Fin}\,M \times \mathrm{Fin}\,N$, and for each row action $i$ let $\sigma^{\mathrm{row}}_i = \sum_{j} \sigma_{ij}$ denote its row marginal. Then the row marginals sum to one:
\[
\sum_{i} \sigma^{\mathrm{row}}_i = 1.
\]
hypotheses_covered: σ is a joint distribution over Fin M × Fin N (nonnegative entries summing to one)
replaced:
The row marginals form a valid probability distribution:
$\sum_{i} \sigma^{\mathrm{row}}_i = 1$.
